citations.narrative:
The licensee didn't document an annual review of the facility contingency plan since 2/12/2024. The licensee reports
reviewing it around May 2026 and found no updates were needed so it was maintained the same. Documenting the
annual review of the contingency plan is required and helps ensure a facility is ready for adverse events. Ensure to
maintain documentation of contingency plan annual reviews, including documenting any amendments or changes made
to the plan since the previous year's review, such as changes made as a result of recently predicted, but historically
unforeseen, circumstances (e.g., weather extremes).
***Correct by 7/31/2026.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with a facility representative.
Additional Inspectors:
